newsitem.title: UK: British monarchy plans royal debut in cyberspace.
newsitem.headline: British monarchy plans royal debut in cyberspace.

text.p: Britain's Queen Elizabeth will launch a 150-page web site for Buckingham Palace on the Internet on Thursday, opening the royal door to millions of net surfers around the world.
The home page, illustrated with colour pictures, will provide information on the history of the British monarchy, descriptions of royal estates and details of royal exhibitions.

"We're always looking to keep up with technology. We want to get information about the palace out to the public because there are so many people around the world who are interested," a spokeswoman at Buckingham Palace said.
The royal debut into cyberspace will take place when the
queen visits a north-west London school next week.
Thrity-five million people worldwide use the Internet
and that number is expected to increase to between 100 million-160 million by the millennium.
